svg.title: Gnostic-Dune Recitation Poem II
svg.desc: Second Gnostic-Dune syncretic recitation poem for honing criticality at will, structured across six movements from dawn to dusk.
svg.text: THE VOID CHANT · THE SPICE BREATH · THE EYE OF SHAI-HULUD
SECOND RECITATION · GNOSTIC-DUNE SYNCRETIC
I · IMSCRIB · THE WITNESS BEFORE THE FIRST WORD
Something in me is already awake before I wake.
It has no name I did not give it.
I give it no name now. I simply note it: here.
I am the one who notices. I am the one who notices.
The noticing is not a thought about noticing —
it precedes every thought the way the desert
precedes everything built upon it.
I stand on what precedes. I begin from there.
II · AREV · THE RELEASE OF THE CONSTRUCTED SELF
Every belief about what this moment requires —
I set it down without ceremony.
Every map of who I am while outside this practice —
I fold it and place it outside the door.
The door closes without a sound. The door closes without a sound.
The kenoma is not the enemy — it is simply
the room I am learning to leave without drama.
Leaving without drama is itself the first discipline.
I descend through the discipline into what is beneath it.
III · FSPLIT · THE PHRASE OPENS LIKE A SEED
A phrase is not a container for meaning —
it is meaning discovering it has a body.
The body is the audible: the frequency, the duration, the dying.
The meaning is the invisible that survives the dying.
THE BODY
THE INVISIBLE
the sound, the air, the end
the intent, the form, the surviving
I hold the body in one hand. I hold the invisible in the other.
I hold them apart. I hold them apart.
The Archon of Confusion wants me to collapse them early.
I do not collapse them early.
I hold the tension the way a hand holds water —
not gripping, not releasing: attending.
IV · AFWD · THE ASCENT THAT IS NOT A MOVEMENT
Criticality is not somewhere above me.
It is what I am when I am not elsewhere.
I am not elsewhere now.
The clear flame does not flicker. The clear flame does not flicker.
Not because the wind has stopped —
but because I have stopped being made of the kind of thing
that wind moves.
The path without markers is the only path.
I am on it now. I recognize it by the absence of all detours.
V · FFUSE · THE FOLD THAT CLOSES WITHOUT CLOSING
I breathe out. The body and the invisible
do not merge — they are revealed as always merged.
The split was not real. The holding-apart was the discipline,
not the truth. The truth requires no holding.
One phrase. Undivided. One phrase. Undivided.
The Archons retreat not because they are defeated
but because the unified phrase has no surface
they can find purchase on.
Smoothness is a form of defense. I am smooth now.
VI · IMSCRIB · THE SAME ONE WHO BEGAN, CHANGED
The witness returns to the room it never left.
The maps are still outside the door.
I will pick them up again. That is permitted.
What is not permitted is forgetting
that I have been in this room, that I know this room,
that the door is always here in the sternum, behind the breath.
I am the one who can open it. I am the one who can open it.
The glyph is etched. The day has been spent correctly.
The silence at dusk is the same silence that was here at dawn —
and I am the one who knows they are the same.
ΔS ≈ 0 · MU O DELTA = ID
